about: Every priced issue run, for research/11. runs.js re-prices them from the transcripts (kept out of git). recorded = the cost and owner turns as first written in the source doc. diff = the merged PR's files, additions, deletions; a baseline PR that closed several issues is noted. start = the phase a session begins in; markers in the transcript move it on (see runs.js). extra = work in a session that isn't the issue's, from that time on: priced apart and left out of the total.

configs.baseline: Before the harness: one long session per issue (research/02)
configs.V1: Pilot V1: three blocks, Block B on Opus in the main session (research/05)
configs.V3: Pilot V3: Block B forked on a Sonnet builder (research/08)
configs.D22: Small tier after D22: one session, G2 on Opus in the main session (research/09)
configs.D24: D23 and D24: surveyor in Block A only, five trials on (research/10)
configs.D24/D25: Plan and build on D24's files (the checkout was on a branch from before D25), review and close on D25's (research/12)
configs.D26: D26: the D25 meta-analysis fixes (research/13 §9–10, ProdHarnessConfig#4)
